title: 定语从句的连接
goal: 按先行词和从句成分选择关系词；将定语从句接到对应名词之后。

body.p: 限制性定语从句说明名词指的是哪一个，紧跟在先行词后面，不用逗号隔开。关系词在从句里也充当一个成分。选关系词时，先看先行词是人还是物，再看从句缺什么成分。

body.box: The students who maintain the roof garden meet every Friday beside the greenhouse.

body.p: who 指 students，在从句里作 maintain 的主语。主句的谓语是 meet。从句里不能再加 they。

cards.title: 人物与所属关系
rows: who：主语
先行词是人，who 在从句里作主语。
A student repairs radios. He joined our group. → The student who repairs radios joined our group at the start of this term.
who：宾语
who 在从句里作宾语，不再加 her。
We invited a tutor. She teaches pottery. → The tutor who we invited teaches pottery to local residents at the community center.
whose：所属
whose 后面直接接名词，不再加 her。
A runner lost her shoes. She borrowed a pair. → The runner whose shoes were missing borrowed a pair from the sports office.
whose：所属
whose 和后面的名词一起作从句的主语。
A team won a prize. Its project reused paper. → The team whose project reused paper won a prize at the student exhibition.

cards.title: 事物与从句位置
rows: which：主语
先行词是物，which 作主语，后面直接接谓语。
A machine sorts envelopes. It needs repair. → The machine which sorts envelopes needs repair before the next batch of letters arrives.
which：宾语
which 在从句里作宾语，不再加 it。
We bought a map. It shows local footpaths. → The map which we bought shows several quiet footpaths through the nearby hills.
that：指人
限制性从句里可代替 who。逗号后面不用 that。
A volunteer speaks Polish. She will guide the guests. → The volunteer that speaks Polish will guide the guests around the new exhibition.
that：指物
限制性从句里可代替 which。例句中 that 作 designed 的宾语。
The club designed a badge. It has a green border. → The badge that the club designed has a green border around its name.
位置
从句紧跟在所修饰的名词后面。
The student who records interviews lent a microphone to the history club yesterday.
省略
关系词作宾语时可以省略，作主语时不能省。
The samples the group collected are stored in clearly labeled boxes near the window.

body.box: A student sent a proposal to the committee. The proposal included a courtyard drawing. The committee discussed it on Monday. Which noun should the clause that included a courtyard drawing follow?

body.p: 要说明的是 proposal，included 的主语也是 proposal，所以从句紧跟 proposal。放在 committee 后面，从句就成了修饰 committee。

body.box: On Monday, the committee discussed the proposal that included a drawing of the courtyard.

body.p: that 已经代替 proposal，不能再写 that it included。同样，whose pages 不能写成 whose its pages。

items.stem: Which word marks ownership? The cyclist ___ helmet was damaged borrowed a spare one from the club.
items.why: helmet 属于 cyclist，需用 whose helmet。

items.stem: Which revision removes a repeated subject from The students who they restore furniture meet on Fridays?
items.why: who 已经作 restore 的主语，they 重复，应删去，即第三项。删去 who，两个分句就没有了连接。

items.stem: The description concerns the workshop, not its organizer. Which placement preserves that meaning?
options: The workshop that teaches weaving has a new organizer.
The workshop has an organizer that teaches weaving.
The organizer that has a workshop teaches weaving.
The new organizer that teaches weaving has a workshop.
items.why: 题干要求从句描述 workshop。第一项把 that teaches weaving 直接接在 workshop 后面。

items.stem: Which revision removes a repeated object from The camera which I borrowed it has a broken strap?
items.why: which 已经代替 camera 作 borrowed 的宾语，it 重复，应删去，即第四项。I 是从句的主语，不能删。

groups.text: A craft team printed a guide to assembling paper lanterns. Each student received a guide and a folder for loose designs. One student requested a new folder because the original was torn. The guide contained clear diagrams of each stage, and the team kept spare copies in the office.

items.stem: Complete the sentence identifying the owner of the torn folder.
items.tail: a new one from the office.
items.why: whose folder 表示所属。was torn 是从句的谓语，requested 是主句的谓语。

items.stem: Insert a relative word: The guide ___ the team printed contains clear diagrams of each stage.
items.why: guide 是物，关系词作 printed 的宾语，which 和 that 都可以。题目要求填关系词，不能空着。

items.stem: Which word shows possession? The singer ___ recording won the college award thanked the student sound team.
items.why: recording 属于 singer，应为 whose recording。

items.stem: Which repair removes the repeated subject? The workers who they maintain the lifts attend a monthly briefing.
items.why: who 已作 maintain 的主语，they 是多余代词。

items.stem: The report compares three designs. Which sentence attaches that description to the report?
options: The report reached the supervisor who compared three designs.
The supervisor who read the report compared three designs.
The report that compared three designs reached the supervisor.
The supervisor compared three designs that appeared in the report.
items.why: 题干要求从句说明 report。第三项把 that compared three designs 接在 report 后面。

items.stem: Which sentence places the clause beside the noun it describes and avoids a repeated object?
options: The gloves which the instructor recommended them arrived yesterday.
The gloves arrived which the instructor recommended yesterday.
The instructor which recommended the gloves arrived yesterday.
The gloves which the instructor recommended arrived yesterday.
items.why: 第四项的 which 作 recommended 的宾语，紧跟 gloves。第一项多了 them，宾语重复。

items.stem: Identify the student whose design won the award.
items.why: whose design 是从句的主语，won the award 是从句的谓语部分。received 是主句的谓语。

items.stem: Complete the sentence about the device that measures indoor light.
items.tail: a new battery before the test.
items.why: which 作 measures 的主语，requires 是主句的谓语。it 不是关系词，不能连接从句。

items.stem: Insert a relative word: The instrument ___ measures wind speed stands beside the old sports field.
items.why: instrument 是物，关系词作 measures 的主语。which、that 都可以，作主语时不能省略。

items.stem: Insert a relative word: The volunteers ___ lead the walking tours receive maps from the local office.
items.why: volunteers 是人，关系词作 lead 的主语，who 和 that 都可以。
